title: Baselaird
summary: Baselaird is a Krono-Titan inherited by Lok Lambert from his father, Eathon Lambert, and appears as a warrior of the sun. Though his base stats are relatively low, Baselaird quickly became one of Lok's primary Titans. With Baselaird's large shield and powerful curved sword, this golden-armored Titan is not one to be trifled with.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Baselaird was one of Eathon Lambert's strongest Titans and was later recovered by his son, Lok Lambert, at the Temple of Poseidon near the entrance to Atlantis after the team solved a riddle, left to him by his dad using a box only Lok could see. Lok later invoked it after sensing his name through the bond. [The Unseen Guide] Later, in Atlantis, Baselaird was summoned by a raging Lok in his one-on-one fight against Rassimov. He helped defeat Thornment and fought against Sekhmet. He then tackled Anubian to the Casterwill compound's entrance, which the Atlantis Guardian closed at Lok's orders, instantly sending Anubian back to its amulet. [Coming of Age]

On the team's way to the Golden Asp, Lok again summoned Baselaird after being grabbed by Unnamed Suit 040's Bonelasher. He quickly sent the Suit's Titan back to its amulet by stomping on it after a poor attempt from Bonelasher to slash Baselaird's shield. [The Golden Asp]

In the ambush to recover the Legendary Titans from the team, this Titan was invoked by Lok to fight off Shauna and her Titans in the streets of Venice. However, he was swiftly paralyzed by her Dervish. [The Secret of Two Generations]

Baselaird was used to launch Dendras' marionettes torwards Overlos in the final battle against the Professor, making Lok be able to control Overlos after Archwarder disrupted the Professor's control of the Legendary Titan. [The Mission] 

Lok became Powerbonded with Baselaird during a mission of great personal importance to him, summoning him to fight against the Organization outside the Nexus in Peru. Lok ordered him to use Sword Strike against a Gigadrone Titan and also defeat Hoffman's Myrmidon, making Wilder and his group retreat. [Doorway to Huntik]

Inside the secret chamber of the Tower of Nostradamus, Lok summoned Powerbonded Baselaird to fight the Organization. In response, Wilder invoked Incubane and the two Titans fought until Hoffman hit Lok with Poisonfang, making Powerbonded Baselaird briefly fall to his knees; ultimately, both Titans sent each other to their respective amulets. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Cherit managed to sneak Powerbonded Baselaird's amulet inside the Organization vehicle Lok and Sophie Casterwill were trapped in, and the Titan was invoked to break open the car from the inside. Unnamed Suit 055 later fired a Raypulse against Baselaird's shield, who responded by sending him flying by striking him with his shield. [Chasing Void] 

Lok again used Powerbonded Baselaird inside Klaus' bookshop to fight off the Organization in the search for Void's amulet. He took out a Redcap Titan with his Shooting Slash ability after a long struggle, then swiftly sent a Gigadrone Titan back to its amulet as the team started heading to the underground laboratory. [The Blood Spiral]

Powerbonded Baselaird was summoned by Lok to fight off the three Titans invoked by Arc next to the Cathedral of Notre Dame after he struggled to do so with the Willblade. He helped Lok defeat Ironsquire by shattering part of his shield and also took out Freelancer. Later on, Lok attempted to again invoke Baselaird inside Arc's dream to fight multiple Harlekins after his Freelancer turned into a Harlekin Titan; however, summoning Baselaird only made another one appear. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]

ON Medusa's Island, Powerbonded Baselaird was used to battle Kiel and the Casterwill Hunters. He fought multiple Harlekins and later Kiel's Vulcana. After a long struggle, Baselaird grabbed Vulcana's fiery body with his hand, taking her out but also being sent back to his amulet in the process. [Zhalia's Mission]

This Titan was again invoked by Lok in the Phoenix Volcano in an ambush against Shauna and Wind. He grabbed Wind so that Lok could restrain him with Ropetrick. After the two Blood Spiral Seekers freed themselves, Powerbonded Baselaird fought the powerful Shakrit, without much success; later, he defeated Ash by throwing her torwards a lava pool and briefly struggled against Lilith the Queen. In order to finally defeat Shakrit, Lok used Baselaird's Focus Blade ability so that Baselaird could lend him his Powerbonded energy. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

Powerbonded Baselaird was again summoned to help Dante Vale and Grier against the two Undergolem Titans invoked by Eathon the dog in the Professor's castle. In the long battle that followed, he took out the two Undergolems as well as Hoffman's Doberman. After Lok managed to retrieve Rassimov's files from the castle, he called Baselaird back to his Amulet. [An Ally from the Organization]

As the team waited for information on the Spiral Mark's location, Lok invoked Powerbonded Baselaird to fight Psikofen by Nostradamus' Tomb. After a tense standoff between the Titans, Baselaird waited for Psikofen to charge before defeating him. Lok then called him back to his amulet. [Words from Eathon] At the Spiral Mark, Baselaird was again summoned to hold off Legion but was overpowered by the Legendary Titan. He was nearly permanently absorobed but Lok ordered him to return to his Amulet just in time. [The Spiral Mark] Later, during the battle between the Foundation, Casterwills and the Blood Spiral, Lok invoked Baselaird to fight off two Marauders; after defeating the two Titans, Lok called him back to his Amulet. [Lok and the Betrayer]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E21 Baselaird Anubian.png|thumb|Baselaird tackles [[Anubian]] with the aid of his shield]]
A favored [[Titan]] of the legendary Seeker [[Eathon Lambert]], Baselaird is among the purest brawler Titans. He possesses no magical attacks, but rather is totally reliant on his sword and large shield, as well as his raw strength and martial arts ability. He's seen without his sword sometimes, when he's syncronizes with [[Dendras]] to control opposing Titans. {{Source|The Mission}} He is also an agile and strong Titan, being able to take out Titans such as [[Bonelasher]] just by stomping on them, {{Source|The Golden Asp}} as well as dragging [[Anubian]] through the ground a large distance just by tackling it. {{Source|Coming of Age}}

sections.heading: Powerbonding
sections.text:
from Vulcana's fire]]
When the bond with his Seeker became stronger, Baselaird became stronger as well as changing significantly in appearance. Where his armor was originally mostly brown and covered a majority of his body, golden armor now predominantly covers his torso with a long red cape attached to it, and a portion of his legs with golden boots while some skin can be seen on his arms and legs. His helmet - where it once showed his eyes along with five small spikes, changed to have three long, curved spikes protruding from it, now concealing his eyes. He became able to communicate with his Seeker via telepathy and respond to his commands. Baselaird's shield and sword both became considerably larger in size. In contrast, his sword became attatched to his arm, which can make him vunerable in case it gets stuck. [Lok and the Betrayer] His Powerbonding abilities include:
*Double Aggression - enhances his combat skills when facing off two or more enemies. [The Legendary Titan of Fate] [Zhalia's Mission] 
*Focus Blade - allows Baselaird to lend all of his energy to his Seeker so as to enhance their offensive strikes. [The Phoenix's Ashes]
*Leading Charge - enables him to charge at an enemy at speed from a distance. [The Phoenix's Ashes] [The Spiral Mark]
* absorbs Baselaird's powerbonded energy using Focus Blade]]Shooting Slash - fires a powerful ray of energy directly from his sword [The Tower of Nostradamus] [The Blood Spiral] or by striking the ground with it. [The Legendary Titan of Fate] Alternatively, it can swipes an enemy with his sword with additional power. [The Phoenix's Ashes] [Lok and the Betrayer]
*Sword Strike - Baselaird swipes an enemy with his sword. [Doorway to Huntik]
*Total Defense - uses his shield to completely cover himself from incoming attacks. [The Tower of Nostradamus] [Zhalia's Mission]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Baselaird's summoning commands include "'''Beat him'''", "'''Hurry'''" and "'''Stop her'''". In Season 2, his sole command is "'''Bring it on'''".
* Baselaird may be based off ''[[:wikipedia:Helios|Helios]]'', the Greek god of the sun, with his golden armor and spiked helmet.
* Baselaird's name comes from "[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baselard Baselard]", a dagger from the late middle ages. His name is spelt with "laird", which is Scottish for "lord" or "lord of the land".
* Baselaird's amulet is the same size as other amulets in Season 1, but is often weirdly upscaled in Season 2's summoning scenes, as Lok holds it with both hands.
*In the Italian dub, Powerbonded Baselaird's "Shooting Slash" ability is called "Raggio di energia" (literally "Rays of energy").
